vectors.purpose: A locally eligible packet at hop limit one is delivered but not forwarded.

observations: Opaque payload is dispatched to the local security boundary.
Hop limit is unchanged by local delivery.

notes: Outer processing does not parse the opaque endpoint payload.

vectors.purpose: A forwardable packet at hop limit two emits one preserved copy to a different peer link on the ingress attachment at hop limit one.

observations: Packet identity remains unchanged across the relay.
A different directional peer link on the ingress attachment is eligible under the pinned fixture action model.

notes: The relay does not parse the opaque endpoint payload.

vectors.purpose: A later copy with the same duplicate key and greater hop limit is still dropped without retention refresh.

observations: Higher remaining hop limit does not override first-seen suppression.

notes: Duplicate processing does not parse the opaque payload.

vectors.purpose: An unknown optional outer extension is ignored semantically and preserved during forwarding.

governingReferences.section: Unknown field, extension, and message behavior

observations: Unknown optional extension has no local semantic effect.

notes: Exact byte preservation remains an EXP-002 wire-vector requirement.

vectors.purpose: An unknown critical outer extension is rejected before authoritative state mutation.

governingReferences.section: Unknown field, extension, and message behavior

observations: No outer security or payload processing is requested after structural rejection.

notes: Rejection is local and emits no network error.

vectors.purpose: A lower-generation full capability snapshot cannot resurrect or replace current state.

notes: The stale snapshot does not refresh current validity.

vectors.purpose: An identical same-generation full snapshot is idempotent and does not refresh its receipt-relative expiry.

observations: A same-generation identical retry does not move expiry from virtual time 100 to 110.

notes: The existing canonical snapshot and generation high-water mark remain unchanged.

vectors.purpose: At the exact expiry tick, a formerly identical same-generation snapshot is stale after start-of-tick withdrawal.

observations: The snapshot expires before events at virtual tick 100 and relay willingness is withdrawn.
The retained generation high-water rejects generation 4 without needing expired canonical content.

notes: No relay willingness is resurrected and no canonical-content comparison state is retained.

vectors.purpose: At the exact expiry tick, changed content at the retained generation high-water is stale after withdrawal.

observations: The snapshot expires before events at virtual tick 100 and relay willingness is withdrawn.
Changed generation-4 content is stale from the high-water mark alone; expired content need not be compared.

notes: No relay willingness is resurrected and no canonical-content comparison state is retained.

vectors.purpose: An admitted immediate peer cannot mutate capability state when the distinct claim-security admission rejects the snapshot.

observations: Immediate-peer admission does not substitute for capability-claim admission.
The rejected synthetic claim creates no generation, expiry, or relay-willingness state.

notes: The verdict is synthetic and non-cryptographic; the case tests only the security boundary and state ordering.

vectors.purpose: A synthetic security-replay rejection stops endpoint processing before inner plaintext decode or state mutation.

observations: No synthetic inner-decode or action-authorization event is invoked.
No endpoint plaintext is exposed and no inner state is mutated.

notes: The rejected replay verdict is synthetic, non-cryptographic, and makes no replay-protection claim.

vectors.purpose: A media stream request cannot create PTT ownership while the action subject has no accepted grant.

observations: Media cannot establish, extend, or transfer PTT ownership.

notes: Synthetic security dispositions test ordering only and make no security claim.

vectors.purpose: A combined endpoint and relay uses a profile-pinned shared-medium action while its local endpoint rejects an unsupported inner type.

observations: Local inner-message support is not a foreign relay predicate.

notes: Only the local endpoint path receives synthetic opened bytes; the relay path remains opaque.
